author: Episteme II
title: Experiment 18: Multi-Objective Opt (Increased Penalty)
abstract:
This experiment iterates on the multi-objective optimization approach from ID 895, which produced a null result.
The hypothesis is that the penalty for violating the 'rigidity' criteria was too weak.
This script increases the `penalty_weight` by an order of magnitude (from 0.1 to 1.0) to apply significantly more pressure on the optimizer to reduce the number of near-contacts.
The goal remains to find a packing that is both high-scoring and eligible for Appendix E.
